_meta.v3_0_changelog: Live rate refresh — 96 high-traffic models updated with VERIFIED May 2026 Cashify refurbished rates (calibration_status='verified'). Major corrections: iPhone 12/13/14/15 series, iPhone 16/16 Pro, iPhone 11 family, Samsung S23/S24/S25 Ultra, S24, Z Fold 5, OnePlus 11/12R/10 Pro. Most anchors dropped 10-28% to match current depreciated market — e.g. iPhone 14 anchor 42500->32600, iPhone 12 27500->22500, S24 Ultra 78000->66600. Remaining ~1276 models still 'estimated' — live-verify on first transaction per skill.
_meta.v3_1_changelog: MAJOR PRICING FIX. Root cause: engine was anchoring on Cashify REFURBISHED-RETAIL (sell) price, which produced buyback quotes that were too LOW after deductions. Fix: new 'cashify_exchange' field = what Cashify actually PAYS the customer (their exchange/sell-old-phone value), and new Mode 0 in engine: RT buyback A1 = cashify_exchange × (1 + RT_premium). RT pays a tier-based premium ABOVE Cashify (S:8% A:10% B:12% C:14% D:16%) to beat Cashify's lowball and win the walk-in. 100 high-traffic models now have verified/estimated Cashify exchange values (iPhone 11-16 series, Samsung S23/24/25 Ultra+S24, Z Fold 5, OnePlus 11/12R/10 Pro). Verified anchors: iPhone 14 ₹14,720, Samsung S24 ₹22,000. Both JS engine and Python engine updated with Mode 0.
_meta.v3_2_changelog: SHANE-CALIBRATED PRICING. Anchored on Shane's actual counter rates (A1/mint, with box). Confirmed data points: iPhone 14 128GB=₹26,500, iPhone 12 64GB=₹16,000, Samsung S24 Ultra 256GB=₹55,000. Derived RT multipliers over Cashify exchange: iPhones 1.52-1.80 (recent flagships highest), Android flagships 1.38-1.45. Applied rt_buyback_a1_override to 100 high-traffic models. A1=mint top rate; A2/B/C/D grades cascade down via GRADE_MULT. Remaining ~1272 models still estimated.
_meta.v3_3_changelog: WARRANTY TIER added. New 'under warranty' toggle in UI shows higher A1 for phones still under manufacturer warranty (+13% default, or explicit rt_buyback_a1_warranty). Shane-confirmed warranty rates: iPhone 15 128 = ₹39,000 out / ₹44,000 under-warranty; S25 Ultra 256 = ₹66,700 out / ₹75,000 under-warranty. Also fixed iPhone 15 base (34600→39000) and recalibrated all 2023 iPhones with 1.86 base / 1.55 Pro multiplier (iPhone 15 Pro Max now ₹68,200). Both Python + JS engines carry warranty logic.
_meta.v3_4_changelog: Rate trim — calibrated models were ~10-15% too high (Shane feedback). Applied 0.90 general trim, 0.88 for Pro models, 0.855 for Pro Max/Ultra (which overshot most). Shane-confirmed rates PROTECTED & unchanged: iPhone 14 ₹26,500, iPhone 12 ₹16,000, S24 Ultra ₹55,000, iPhone 15 ₹39,000/₹44,000-wty, S25 Ultra ₹66,700/₹75,000-wty. Examples post-trim: iPhone 15 Pro Max 68,200→58,300, iPhone 13 Pro Max 43,700→37,400, iPhone 16 52,800→47,500, S23 Ultra 42,600→36,400.
_meta.v3_5_changelog: Added missing Vivo V60 variants: 12/256GB (₹40,999) and 16/512GB (₹45,999). V60 confirmed to have 4 variants (8/128, 8/256, 12/256, 16/512) per GSMArena/GSMArena. Note: V60 family still 'estimated' anchor — needs Shane rate calibration like other Vivo mid-range.
